Dates.text: Space Shuttle Discovery lifts off with Hubble in its cargo bay.
The first servicing mission launches to correct Hubble's flawed mirror.
The fifth and final servicing mission launches.

Title: Hubble launched
Body-Text: Named after Edwin Hubble, who proved that other galaxies exist, the telescope was ready by 1985, but the Challenger disaster grounded the shuttles. Engineers used the delay to improve it. On 24 April 1990, Discovery carried Hubble to orbit, where astronauts would later service and upgrade it.
